drivers.variant_notes: Colored-ROM modification only; native display colorization does not change physical I/O or mechanisms. Custom acd_170h-derived American Country ROM for the virtual AC/DC LUCI VPW 1.1 reskin; the physical simulation topology is identical while art, audio, DMD content, playlists, and toy names are rethemed.

mechanisms.behavior: Create four balls on switches 18-21. Output 1 ejects the rightmost ball and the proven script pulses stack opto 22 when balls remain.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 23 holds while a ball is in the auto-launch lane. Output 2 fires the impulse plunger; the working scripts use a 55-65 strength implementation-dependent impulse.
mechanisms.label: Auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: A ball closes switch 37 until output 12 ejects it. Premium code can PWM output 12 and the working table preserves the stronger super-skill-shot kick.
mechanisms.label: Jukebox / top eject

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 45 holds a captured ball. The motor sweeps from roughly 110 degrees home toward 20 degrees and back; switch 61 is home and switch 62 is the mid mark. The eject output launches at the current angle and clears switch 45.
mechanisms.label: Rotating cannon / gun

positions.description: Working scripts initialize near 110 degrees with switch 61 active.
positions.label: Home

positions.description: Switch 62 becomes active as the cannon passes the ROM timing mark.
positions.label: Mid mark

mechanisms.behavior: The right-ramp diverter selects normal ramp travel or the cannon capture path. Recreate both physical routes; do not model it as a cosmetic gate.
mechanisms.label: Right-ramp cannon diverter

mechanisms.behavior: The controlled gate changes the right-ramp/right-orbit return path. The VPX script treats energized and released states as distinct collidable gate states.
mechanisms.label: Right control gate

mechanisms.behavior: Two main flippers use dedicated button and normally-closed EOS contacts. PinMAME exposes the dedicated contacts in reverse-numbered public order.
mechanisms.label: Main flippers

mechanisms.behavior: Each bumper contact pulses its corresponding coil; keep the physical switch-to-coil order left, right, bottom.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Each leaf switch pulses its corresponding slingshot coil.
mechanisms.label: Left and right slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: Pulse switch 33 once for each spinner blade transition; do not hold it for a complete spin.
mechanisms.label: Loop spinner

mechanisms.behavior: A one-ball lower-playfield trough holds switch 49 until output 3 ejects it.
mechanisms.label: Lower mini-playfield eject

mechanisms.behavior: The cabinet flipper buttons also close dedicated switches 88 and 86. Outputs 4 and 5 drive the two lower flippers independently of the main pair.
mechanisms.label: Lower mini-playfield flippers

mechanisms.behavior: Each target switch remains active while down. Output 6 raises all five targets together.
mechanisms.label: AC/DC five-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: Each target switch remains active while down. Output 7 raises all three targets together.
mechanisms.label: TNT three-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 36 holds a ball in the bell saucer until public output 52, physical auxiliary coil 42, ejects it.
mechanisms.label: Bell eject

mechanisms.behavior: The bell carries a captive steel ball and must transfer playfield-ball momentum into pendulum motion. Switch 47 reports a score excursion; the working VPX closes it outside the settled angular region. Output 54 is a hidden magnet used by Hells Bells to start the swing.
mechanisms.label: Swinging bell with captive ball

mechanisms.behavior: The left-ramp diverter selects the normal left-ramp return or crossover toward the right-ramp route.
mechanisms.label: Left-ramp crossover diverter

mechanisms.behavior: Public output 51, physical auxiliary coil 41, drives a timed rocking animation across the molded band figures; the script returns the linked members after the pulse.
mechanisms.label: Animated band-member display

mechanisms.behavior: The standup target reports the player's hit on switch 46. Output 18 independently actuates the detonator handle animation.
mechanisms.label: Detonator handle
